name: Sticky Table Stand
summary: A desktop stand that holds reTerminal Sticky at a comfortable viewing angle.
description: A simple table stand that props reTerminal Sticky up at a readable angle for desk use. The CAD files are published on GrabCAD and can be exported to STL for printing.

compatibility.notes: Designed for the production reTerminal Sticky enclosure.
